description: Connect this server to a Snapchat ad account, from inside the chat. Step 1: call with no arguments; it returns a link for the person to open and approve. Step 2: the person pastes the address the browser landed on; call with redirected_url, and it saves access on this computer and lists the ad accounts. Step 3: call with ad_account_id to choose one, then the app must be restarted. Changes no ads. Use once, to connect a Snapchat login and choose the ad account. Not for daily use; use snap_ping to check an existing connection.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id. Optional: defaults to SNAP_AD_ACCOUNT_ID (set by setup). snap_ping shows the current one.

ad_account_name.description: Choose the ad account by (part of) its name instead of its id, for example: Zyros

redirected_url.description: Not needed with the shared login. Only for the own-OAuth-app setup: the address the browser landed on after you approved.

name: snap_connect
